typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Id as string,
		Customer_Id__c as string,
		Salutation as string,
		FirstName as string,
		middle_initial__c as string,
		LastName as string,
		OtherStreet as string,
		OtherCity as string,
		OtherState as string,
		OtherPostalCode as string,
		Phone as string,
		Email as string,
		Deceased__c as string,
		Do_Not_Mail__c as string,
		HasOptedOutOfEmail as string,
		DoNotCall as string,
		Do_Not_Solicit__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['salesforce/ob_kpif_sales_suppression*']) ~> source1
source1 derive(ADDRESS_LINE_1 = rtrim(ltrim(toString(slice(split(OtherStreet, '\n'), 1, 1)), '["'), '"]'),
		ADDRESS_LINE_2 = rtrim(ltrim(toString(slice(split(OtherStreet, '\n'), 2, 2)), '["'), '"]')) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		CONTACT_ID = Id,
		CUSTOMER_ID = Customer_Id__c,
		NAME_PREFIX = Salutation,
		FIRST_NAME = FirstName,
		MIDDILE_INITIAL = middle_initial__c,
		{ LAST_NAME} = LastName,
		ADDRESS_LINE_1,
		ADDRESS_LINE_2,
		CITY = OtherCity,
		STATE = OtherState,
		ZIP = OtherPostalCode,
		PHONE = Phone,
		EMAIL_ADDRESS = Email,
		DECEASED = Deceased__c,
		Do_Not_Mail = Do_Not_Mail__c,
		Do_Not_Email = HasOptedOutOfEmail,
		Do_Not_Call = DoNotCall,
		Do_Not_Solicit = Do_Not_Solicit__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[(concat('ob_kpif_sales_suppression_', toString(currentUTC(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'), '.csv'))],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sink1
